roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Data Intelligence

bullets: Own the platform roadmap: Define and drive a multi-quarter roadmap for the financial data platform. That covers vendor integration, ingestion, normalization, storage, and access…
Unlock smarter decisions: Partner with Data Science and Engineering to build data products and signals, such as income detection, cash-flow features, and repayment indicators…
Expand our data advantage: Lead discovery and evaluation of new financial data sources, APIs, and partnerships beyond core bank data. Take the best of them from pilot to…
Manage key partners: Own relationships with data aggregators and third-party data providers, balancing coverage, cost, and performance.
Raise the bar on data quality: Set standards and monitoring for data accuracy, coverage, latency, and compliance, so every team that relies on this data can trust it.
